item.title: Bebe Rexha Shuts Down Olivia Rodrigo Comparison: ‘I’m Actually Happy for Her’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. Today, we're talking about Bebe Rexha and her refreshing take on female empowerment in the music industry.
[Short music transition]
Host: Recently, Bebe Rexha paid tribute to the late artist Oliver Tree on social media, sharing that they had recorded a song together for her album "Dirty Blonde". However, the conversation took an unexpected turn when a commenter tried to compare her commercial success to Olivia Rodrigo's, saying "Olivia outsold you btw".
[Short music transition]
Host: But instead of taking the bait, Rexha responded with a powerful message: "I'm actually happy for her. No need to put women against each other. Stream DIRTY BLONDE for women empowerment. Livies X Rexhars." This response was widely praised by fans, who appreciated her commitment to supporting fellow female artists.
[Short music transition]
Host: This isn't the first time Rexha has spoken out about industry issues. Last year, she publicly criticized former collaborator G-Eazy, stating that she had been "undermined" and "silenced" by the industry. Although she later removed the post, her message was clear: it's time for change.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Bebe Rexha is taking a stand for women's empowerment and solidarity in the music industry. By celebrating fellow female artists like Olivia Rodrigo, she's proving that there's room for everyone to succeed. Thanks for tuning in to this music update. [Outro music continues to play]
